svg.title: An approved intention still needs a checked execution
svg.desc: A proposal is checked against authority. A permitted proposal uses existing authority or receives any required approval, then passes validation before an execution attempt. The system records observed outcomes. Refusal or invalidation prevents the attempt; an attempted effect can still fail or remain uncertain.
